data.claim: Idempotency is f(f(x))=f(x) where single and repeated application converge to identical state. Safety is the systems property that retried operations do not violate correctness invariants—duplicates may occur but are tolerated or deduplicated. An append-only event log requires safe writers, not idempotent ones, because appending is intrinsically non-idempotent yet the system survives at-least-once delivery if duplicate entries are detectable and harmless during replay.
